properties.rationale: Standing disposition: validation evidence lives in docs/trials/ and in field reports from real use, not as validation-kind Verifications, so the detector is right that the graph cannot see it. Re-acknowledged at 50 capabilities — the id is derived from the affected SET, so it mints a new gap every time a capability is added and the previous acknowledgement cannot carry over. That churn is a finding about the acknowledgement mechanism, not about validation.
